reviews.name: 홍밥풀
reviews.content:
밥풀이는 사료 먹을 때 토핑을 꼭!! 줘야 밥을 먹는 강아지인데요!
토핑 중에서도 맛없는건 아예 입도 안대는 까다로운 입맛입니다ㅠㅠ

근데 바잇미 리틀 팜 베지 믹스는 너무 맛있게 잘 먹더라구요!
그리고 방울양배추, 단호박, 당근, 비트, 사과, 그린빈스 총 6가지 종류가 있어서 골라줄 수 있는게 가장 좋은 것 같아요!!

간식도 건강하고 맛있게 먹을 수 있으니 요 제품은 마음껏 급여할 수 있어서 좋아요 ㅎㅎ
알록달록 예뻐서 밥꾸로도 딱이에요🍎🥬
reviews.content_en:
Bappooli is a picky eater who only eats her food when there's a topping on it!
Among all the toppings, she won't even touch anything that doesn't taste good ㅠㅠ

But she eats BITE ME Little Farm Veggie Mix so well!
And it comes with 6 different types - brussels sprouts, kabocha squash, carrots, beets, apples, and green beans, so I love being able to choose which ones to give her!!

Since the treats are both healthy and delicious, I can give this product generously without worry ㅎㅎ
It looks so colorful and pretty, it's perfect for meal topping too 🍎🥬

reviews.name: 룰****
reviews.content:
그냥 사료만 안먹는 강쥐라 요즘 밥먹을때마다 토핑으로 섞어주고 있어요!
알러지 대마왕 강쥐라 안심하고 급여하기 좋아요 바삭거리며 잘먹어요~!! 
야채가 알록달록해서 밥꾸하는 친구들에게도 추천합니다🍎
reviews.content_en:
My pup just won't eat plain kibble, so I've been mixing this in with every meal lately!
Since she's the allergy queen, I'm so relieved to give it to her. She eats it so crunchily and well~!!
The veggies are so colorful, I'd recommend it to friends who do meal toppers too 🍎

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 고기만 좋아하는 강아지들이라 야채좀 먹일라고 구매했어요. 사료에 급여해주고 있는데 잘 먹습니다 둘다 다이어트 중이라 살도 안찔꺼 같아 좋네요 야채도 많이 먹이면 살찔꺼 같아 사료에 조금씩 섞여서 먹이고 있습니다 다 먹이고 재구매 하겠습니다
reviews.content_en: My dogs only like meat, so I bought this to get them to eat some veggies. I mix it in with their kibble and they eat it well. Since both are on a diet, I don't think they'll gain weight. I mix it little by little with their food so they eat lots of veggies without getting chubby. I'll definitely reorder once we finish this.

reviews.name: 권****
reviews.content:
식이알러지 있는 애들이라  건강한 간식 찾는 중에 
구매했어요~^^
일단 너무 잘 먹고 ! 
크기도 적당해서 사료위에 토핑해줘도 좋을거같아요 .  
좋은건 같이 ~~   친구들 꺼도  같이 겟겟 했습니다 !
reviews.content_en:
My dogs have dietary allergies, so I was looking for healthy treats.
I bought this~^^
First of all, they eat it SO well!
The size is perfect, so it would be great as a topping over kibble.
I loved it so much, I ended up getting some for my friends' dogs too!

reviews.name: 손****
reviews.content:
요즘 맘마에 올려주고있어요
바삭하니 맛있나 봅니다
강아지가 밥시간때 엄청 행북해흐합니다
reviews.content_en:
I've been putting it on top of their meals lately.
It seems pretty crunchy and tasty.
My dog is incredibly happy at mealtime!

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 타브랜드 동결건조도 먹여봤는데 크기가 커서 급여할때 잘라주곤 했었는데 바잇미 제품 크기는 별도로 자르지 않아도 되어서 급여할때도 편하고 저희 강아지가 씹어먹기도 편해서 만족스러워요 ! 크기가 큰 동결건조 잘라주거나 그대로 급여할때는 가루도 떨어지고 자르기가 힘들었는데 이러지 않아도 되니 아주 좋아요 :)
reviews.content_en: I've tried other brands' freeze-dried treats before, and they were so big I always had to cut them up before feeding. But the BITE ME product size is convenient—I don't have to cut it at all, and my dog finds it easier to chew too, so I'm really satisfied! The bigger freeze-dried treats shed powder everywhere and were hard to cut, but I don't have to deal with that anymore, so it's great :)

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 야채 잘먹어서 구매해 봤는데 넘 좋은데요!? 사이즈가 작아서 먹기도 편하고 다른데껀 고구마가 반인데 고구마 안들어 있어서 더좋아요 ㅋㅋ 사과는 저도 먹어봤는데 달다구리 넘 맛있네요🤎
reviews.content_en: I bought it because my dog eats veggies well, and wow, I'm really impressed!? The size is small so it's easy to eat, and unlike other brands where sweet potato makes up half, this one doesn't have sweet potato in it, which is even better ㅋㅋ I even tried the apple and it's so deliciously sweet 🤎

reviews.name: 윤****
reviews.content:
재구매했어요♥
밥 위에 토핑으로 뿌려주면 예쁘기도하고 
무엇보다 저희집 간나지가 잘 먹어요!
여러가지 채소들이 먹기좋은 크기로 되어있어
간편하고 좋아요 :D
reviews.content_en:
I've reordered it ♥
When I sprinkle it as a topping over their kibble, it looks pretty AND
most importantly, my pup eats it so well!
The vegetables are all cut to a nice size that's easy to eat,
so it's convenient and great :D

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
다이어트 저알러지 간식 찾고있었는데..사료구입하면서 눈에 띄더라구요!

받자마자 난리가나서 얼른 꺼내주었어요!

알갱이가 아주 작아서 토핑으로도 좋겠더라구요! (방울양배추만 통으로 들어있어요)
100% 야채라서 다이어트에도 좋구 알러지도 없을거 같아서 선택했는데 역시나!
믿고 구입하길 잘했단생각이 들었고 30g이라 금방 먹을듯해요!
몇개 더 구입해서 쟁여놓고 싶은!
방울양배추 통도 잘 부셔지고 너무 잘 먹어요~
아삭아삭 소리 넘 좋아라~~~~
이름처럼 리틀 팜 베지 믹스 찰떡입니다:)
reviews.content_en:
I was looking for a diet-friendly, low-allergen treat... and I noticed this when I was ordering kibble!

My pup went crazy as soon as I opened it, so I gave it to them right away!

The pieces are really small, so they're great as a topping too! (The brussels sprouts come whole)
100% vegetables, so it's good for dieting and shouldn't cause any allergies, which is why I chose it, and of course it's perfect!
I'm so glad I trusted my instinct and bought it, and since it's only 30g, I think they'll finish it quickly!
I want to stock up on a few more!
The whole brussels sprouts pieces break apart so easily and they eat them so well~
I love the crispy crunchy sound~~~~
True to its name, Little Farm Veggie Mix is a perfect match :)

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
아이가 장이 약해서 간식을 야채 위주로 주는데
크기도 먹기 좋을 정도로 작고 야채향도 하나하나 다 맡아질 정도로 건강한 간식 같아요
아이에게 주자마자 너무 신나게 잘 먹네요
미니 양배추는 크기가 좀 있어서 꽤 오래 꼭꼭 씹어 먹어요
재주문 의향 완전 있어요💙
reviews.content_en:
My pup's stomach is sensitive, so I mainly give veggie treats.
The size is small and easy to eat, and it smells like healthy treats with distinct veggie scents one by one.
As soon as I give it to my pup, they eat it so enthusiastically.
The little brussels sprouts are fairly big so my pup chews on them quite a while.
Definitely planning to reorder 💙

reviews.name: 정****
reviews.content:
40그람일때 묶음으로 사서 먹였는 데 너무 잘 먹어서 재구매 했어요. 꽉꽉채운 40그람 좋았는 데
물가 상승으로 어쩔 수 없이 가격상승되서 저는70그람으로 픽했습니다.

아이 동결건조밥에 추가로 넣어주다 보니 열흘이면 40그람 한통이 비워지는 것 같아요.
40그람통과 비교하니 많이 크네용
다먹은 빈통 버릴 때마다 아까웠는데 큰거 사니 쓰레기 하나 씩 줄겠어용. 단종 안되고 오래 팔면 좋겠어용. 진짜 실한 동결건조 채소간식으로 만족해용
reviews.content_en:
I used to buy it in bundles when it was 40 grams and my pup ate it so well that I reordered. I really liked the tightly packed 40 grams, but due to inflation, I went with the 70 gram option.

Since I add it to my pup's freeze-dried meals, one 40 gram container empties in about 10 days.
Compared to the 40 gram container, the 70 gram is quite a bit bigger.
Every time I threw out the empty 40 gram container, I felt wasteful, but getting the bigger size cuts down on trash. I hope it doesn't get discontinued and stays available for a long time. I'm really satisfied with these substantial freeze-dried veggie treats.

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content: 멍멍이가 자기간식인줄 알아보네요ㅋㅋ 달라고 엄청 난리치구 하나 주니까 너무 맛있나봐요 계속달라고 하네요ㅠ 양도 엄청 많구 야채로만 구성되어있어서 멍멍이 알러지걱정없이 먹일수 있어서 너무 좋아요~! 크기자체도 작아서 잘라줄 필요없이 바로바로 줄 수 있어서도 좋네요! 오랫동안 재입고 기다리다가 주문했는데 너무 마음에 들어요ㅎㅎ
reviews.content_en: My pup recognizes these as their treat ㅋㅋ They go crazy asking for more, and when I give them one, they seem to think it's so delicious, they keep asking for more ㅠ The amount is huge and it's made entirely of vegetables, so I can feed it without worrying about allergies~! Since the pieces themselves are small, I don't have to cut them and can give them right away, which is great! I waited a long time for it to come back in stock before ordering, and I'm so happy with it ㅎㅎ

reviews.name: 얀****
reviews.content:
나 바잇미 명예소방관 시켜주라줘 ‼️
베지믹스 너무 간편하고 사료랑 섞어서 주면 건강도 보기에도 넘 좋아요 !! 방울 양배추가 더많애 들어있는 버전으로 대형견 멈머들을 위해 대용량 통에 담아서 나왔으면 조케써요 ♥
reviews.content_en:
Make me an honorary firefighter at BITE ME ‼️
The veggie mix is so convenient, and when I mix it with their kibble, it looks and is healthy !! I wish they'd make a larger bulk container version with more brussels sprouts for big dog moms ♥

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
지금까지 여럿 동결건조 먹여봤어요. 유명한 것부터 시작해도 전 안 해본 것이 없었는데 이상하게 끝물에는 항상 눅눅해지더라고요.ㅜㅜ 그게 괜히 찝찝해 버리고 새로 사고를 반복하다 이번에 바잇미 닭 가슴살 먹여보고 다 먹일 때까지 파삭파삭한 게 유지가 되길래 이렇게 베지 믹스도 주문하게 됐어요!

역시나 마음에 들고요. 평소 야채를 잘 안 먹는 아기라 사료에 토핑처럼 뿌려 주고 있는데 잘 먹어요. ㅎㅎ 간혹 비트가 털에 붙으면 붉그스름하게 물들기도 해요 ㅋㅋ

암튼 제가 원했던 파사삭 파사삭 눅눅함 전혀 없는 촉감에 만족스럽습니다☺️☺️ 재구매하러 갈게요~~❤️
reviews.content_en:
I've tried several freeze-dried treats so far. I've tried the famous ones and pretty much everything, but I found that they always get soggy toward the end for some reason ㅜㅜ That bothered me so I'd throw them away and buy new ones repeatedly. But this time I tried BITE ME chicken breast and it stayed crispy and crunchy all the way until it was finished, so I decided to order the veggie mix too!

I love it as expected. My pup normally doesn't eat veggies well, so I sprinkle it as a topping on kibble, and they eat it. ㅎㅎ Sometimes when beet sticks to their fur, it turns a reddish tint ㅋㅋ

Anyway, I'm satisfied with the crispy, crispy texture I wanted with absolutely no sogginess ☺️☺️ I'm going back to reorder~~❤️

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
3갤된 저희 아가 간식 알아보다 구매했어요!
처음 줬을때 입에 넣다 뱉어 안먹는줄 알았는데
맛보고난뒤엔 맛있는지 엄청 좋아하네요!!
통 흔들기만 해도 주는줄 알고 달려와용!!~~~~
reviews.content_en:
I'm a 3-year-old pup and I found this while looking for treats!
The first time I gave it to them, I thought they wouldn't eat it because they spit it out,
but after tasting it, they seem to think it's so yummy and absolutely love it!!
They just hear the bottle shake and know I'm giving them treats and come running~~~~

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
예전부터 먹여보고 싶었는데 ㅎㅎ 이제야 구매했네요
기호성 너무 좋고 씹는 소리 넘 귀여워요 ㅋㅋㅋ
reviews.content_en:
I've been wanting to try it for a while ㅎㅎ Finally bought it now
The palatability is so good and the chewing sound is so cute ㅋㅋㅋ

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
진짜 제일 구매하고싶엇던 간식중에 하나예요^^ 
알림 뜨자마자 일단 두개 먼저 구매햇는데 
바로 다음날 배송받은거 같아요! 
야채를 먹이고 싶은 엄마의 맘처럼 
잘먹엇으면 햇는데 다행히 좋아해요! 
요즘 하루에 한번꼴로 바잇미에서 물건 구매하는
느낌적인 느낌이네요^^
요것도 다 먹으면 또 재구매하려구요:)
아 그리고 진짜 내용물이 가득담겨 잇어서 너무 좋아요!
reviews.content_en:
It's seriously one of the treats I wanted to buy the most ^^
As soon as the notification popped up, I bought two first
and it seemed like I got it delivered the very next day!
I was hoping my pup would eat veggies like a mom wants them to,
and thankfully they do!
It feels like I'm buying something from BITE ME every day these days ^^
Once they finish this, I'm definitely reordering :)
Oh and the packaging is so full, I'm so happy about that!

reviews.name: 윤****
reviews.content:
7개월차 댕댕임니당♥
채소도 좀 먹으면 좋을 것 같아서 구매해봤어요!
요즘 밥먹을때마다 섞어주고 있는데 잘 먹어요~
밥이 알록달록 너무 예뻐졌어요ㅎㅎㅎㅎ
가격도 좋고 강아지가 잘 먹을 수 있는 크기여서 좋아요!
reviews.content_en:
I have a 7-month-old pup ♥
I bought this because I thought it would be good to feed some veggies!
I've been mixing it in with their meals lately and they eat it well~
Their kibble looks so colorful and pretty now ㅎㅎㅎㅎ
The price is great and the size is perfect for my dog to eat!

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
베지는 처음먹는 5개월 되어가는 포메남아 우우입니다♡ 사료 , 개껌에 뭐든 잘먹는 아이라 걱정은 안했지만 우드스틱은 쳐다도 안보길래 살짝 걱정했는데 우왕 넘 잘먹어요 과자먹듯 와사삭! 배변훈련 보상으로도 좋을거같아요 
허겁지겁 꿀떡 삼키는아인데 바삭바삭 씹는것도 넘귀엽고 신기~  ❛˓◞˂̵✧
reviews.content_en:
This is my first time trying veggies, and I'm a 5-month-old Pomeranian boy 우우♡ I wasn't worried since my pup eats everything—kibble and dog chews—but I was a bit concerned about the wood sticks since my pup wouldn't even look at them. But wow, they eat it so well! Super crunchy like snacking on cookies! It would be great as a potty training reward too.
My pup gulps it down so quickly, but the crispy crunchy chewing is so cute and interesting~ ❛˓◞˂̵✧

reviews.name: 지****
reviews.content:
그 유명한 리틀 팜 베지 믹스....
즈히 집 애기도 간식이 가능한 개월수가 돼서 구매해봤어요!
딱히 가리는 건 없어서 걱정 없이 줘봤는데 와삭바삭하면서 잘 먹더라구요ㅎㅎ
쭉 놔두고 봤더니 아무래도 당근을 제일 좋아하는 것 같아요ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
야채라서 칼로리 걱정도 좀 덜하고 알러지 걱정도 좀 덜 할 수 있어서 좋아요
애기가 잘먹어서 더더욱 좋구요ㅎㅎ
아무래도 계속 재구매하면서 먹일 것 같습니다!
reviews.content_en:
That famous Little Farm Veggie Mix....
My baby finally reached the age where they can have treats, so I bought it!
Since my pup isn't picky about food, I gave it without worry and they ate it so well with a nice crunch ㅎㅎ
When I just left it out to watch, my pup seems to like carrots the most ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Since it's vegetables, I worry less about calories and allergies too.
And it's even better that my baby eats it so well ㅎㅎ
I'll probably keep reordering and feeding it for a while!

reviews.name: 최****
reviews.content: 첫째는 다이어트 중이고 둘째는 아직 아가라 고기 간식 주기가 조심스러워서 야채 간식 찾던 중에 바잇미 배지믹스가 리뉴얼 되었더라구요! 조금씩 자주 주는걸 선호해서 늘 조각내주는데 야채간식은 부스러기도 많이 떨어져서 애매한데 리뉴얼 되고 조각 크기가 작아져서 한입씩 주기 정말 좋아요 :)
reviews.content_en: My first pup is on a diet and my second is still a baby, so I was hesitant about giving meat treats. I was looking for veggie treats when I saw BITE ME Veggie Mix got relaunched! I usually prefer to give small portions often, so I always break them up, but with veggie treats there's usually lots of crumbling. The relaunch made the piece size smaller, which is perfect for giving one piece at a time :)

reviews.name: y****
reviews.content:
갑자기 아이가 먹던 사료 알러지가 심해지면서 간식까지 모두 처분하고 알러지 없는 제품으로 찾다가 발견했어요
좀 딱딱한듯 바삭거리는지 잘 먹네요
가루가 좀 많이 떨어져요
알러지 걱정없이 먹을수 있는게 있어서 얼마나 다행인지 모르겠어요
reviews.content_en:
My pup suddenly developed serious allergies to their regular kibble, so I had to get rid of all their treats and find allergy-free products. That's when I found this.
It has a nice crispy crunch and they eat it well.
There's quite a bit of powder that falls off.
I can't tell you how relieved I am to have something they can eat without allergy worries.

reviews.name: 박****
reviews.content: 진짜 맛있어하구 좋아하네용 채소라 더 믿음직 스럽고 아기한테도 좋을거같아서 급여할때도 마음이 놓여요 또 구매할게요
reviews.content_en: They really seem to love it and enjoy it so much! Since it's vegetables, it feels more trustworthy and good for my pup, so I feel at ease when giving it. I'll buy it again.

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
베지간식 품절풀렸길래 주문성공
와근데 뚜껑열어보고 이렇게까지 꽉찼을지 몰랐는데 아주 꾹꾹 눌러담겨있어서 깜놀했네요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ 가루가 좀 떨어지긴하는데 혜자스럽네요
reviews.content_en:
The veggie treat finally came back in stock so I managed to order it.
But when I opened the lid, I couldn't believe how packed it was—really stuffed tight ㅋㅋㅋㅋ There is some powder that falls, but it's such great value!

reviews.name: 성****
reviews.content:
품절기다렸다가 재구매했어요
야채 안먹는 아이들 사료에 토핑으로 올려주기 좋아용
reviews.content_en:
I waited for it to come back in stock and reordered.
It's great for putting on kibble as a topping for pups that don't eat veggies.

reviews.name: 유****
reviews.content: 저희 강쥐가 잘 먹어요 채소라 살 안찔거같아서 칭찬용으로 부담없어요! 아삭바삭 소리가 너무 좋아요ㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠ계속 듣고싶을 정도..양도 생각한것보다 넉넉히 많아요
reviews.content_en: My pup eats it so well! Since it's vegetables, I don't think they'll gain weight, so I give it as praise without worry! The crispy crunchy sound is so good ㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠ I could listen to it forever.. The amount is also more generous than I expected.

reviews.name: 방****
reviews.content: 엄청 좋아해요. 일주일에 한통씩 먹어 치우는것 같아요. 가격은 좀 비싸지만 먹이기 편하고 애기도 좋아하고 ~~
reviews.content_en: They love it so much. It seems like we go through one container a week. The price is a bit high, but it's convenient to give, my pup loves it~~

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 진짜로 심각하게 꽉차있어요 ㅎㅎ 먹여보고 잘 먹으면 추가 구매 할게요
reviews.content_en: It's seriously packed so full ㅎㅎ Once I see how well they eat it, I'll order more.

reviews.name: 다****
reviews.content:
너무 잘먹어서
두개 재구매했어요
reviews.content_en:
They eat it so well that
I reordered two more.

reviews.name: 하****
reviews.content: 적당한 크기로 컷팅되어 있어서 급여하기 너무 편해요 :) 다이어트중인 아이들 보상간식으로도 딱이고, 매 끼 밥에 토핑으로도 딱이네요👌🏻 다 먹으면 당연히 재구매각입니다💚
reviews.content_en: It's cut to just the right size so it's so easy to serve :) It's perfect as a reward treat for pups on a diet, and perfect as a topping for every meal too 👌🏻 Definitely reordering once we finish 💚

reviews.name: h****
reviews.content:
베지믹스 재입고 기다렸다 4개 구입했어요
칭찬 간식으로 자주 주고있고 잘아서 엄청 오래먹겠어요
reviews.content_en: I've been waiting for VEGGIE MIX to restock and bought 4 containers! I give it to my pup frequently as a praise treat and she loves it so much that it'll last us a really long time.

reviews.name: w****
reviews.content: 배송도 빠르고 저희 강아지가 너무 잘먹어요 만족합니다 ㅎㅎ
reviews.content_en: Shipping was fast and my dog eats it so well! Very satisfied hehe

reviews.name: e****
reviews.content:
와~~ 오전에 물건 받고 때마침 강아지 밥 줄 시간이라 몇개 섞어 줄려고 뚜껑을 열었더니 제가 찍어 올린 사진에서 보셨듯 내용물이 빈공간없이 꽉꽉 채워져 있어 놀랐어요@@
처음에는 비싸다 생각해 고민하다 주문한건데..
금액 상관없이 내용물이 너무 알차다는 느낌이 들면서 울 강아지 건강해지겠다는 생각에 기쁘네요ㅎㅎ

여러종류 야채들이 작게 담겨있어 밥 위에 몇개 톡톡 뿌려주니 어색함없이 잘 먹어요^^ 비트는 바닥에 뱉어서 걱정했는데 마지막에 주워 먹네요. 건강 생각해서 꾸준히 야채 섭취해 줘야겠어요. 재구매각입니다~~
reviews.content_en:
Wow~~ I received the package this morning and when I opened the lid right around feeding time to mix a few in, I was shocked to see it packed completely full with no empty spaces, just like in the photos I posted! 😲😲 At first I thought it was pricey and hesitated before ordering, but... now I don't care about the price at all—the contents are just so packed with value that I'm so happy thinking about how healthy my pup will become hehe

The various vegetables are packed small inside, so when I sprinkle a few on top of her food, she eats them without any fuss^^ I was worried about the beets being spit out at the bottom, but she ends up eating them all in the end. I should keep giving her veggies consistently for her health. Definitely repurchasing~~

reviews.name: 손****
reviews.content:
오늘 99일째 된 루비에게 첫 간식으로 리틀 팜 베지 믹스를 급여했어요.
아직 애기다보니 간식이 몸에 안좋을까 싶기도 하고,간식 맛을 느끼면 사료를 안먹을까 싶더라구요.
자연의 맛을 찾다가 바잇미에서 딱 맞는 상품을 찾았어요.
건강한 자연의 맛 ♡
기호성도 좋고,색깔도 알록달록 골라서 주는 재미도 있네요.
야채 싫어하는 댕댕이들에게도 안성맞춤!
첫 간식으로 너무 탁월한 선택을 한 내 자신 칭차내~~
앉아 훈련 시키고 베지 믹스 하나씩 줬는데 너무 잘 먹길래
다시 앉아 시키고 사료를 줬더니 퉤퉤 뱉어버려요 ㅋㅋㅋ
중간에 들어있는 양배추는 정말 방울방울 귀엽게 생겼네요.
성공적인 아기강아지 첫 간식 리뷰였습니당!!
reviews.content_en: Today I gave Ruby, who's 99 days old, BITE ME Little Farm Veggie Mix as her first treat. Since she's still a baby, I was worried that treats might not be good for her body, and I was concerned she might not eat her regular food if she tastes treat flavors. I was looking for the taste of nature and found the perfect product at BITE ME. The healthy taste of nature ♡ The palatability is great, and the colorful pieces are fun to pick and give one by one. Perfect for pups that hate veggies! I'm so proud of myself for making such an excellent choice for a first treat~~ I taught her to sit and gave her one Veggie Mix piece at a time, and she ate it so well that when I had her sit again and gave her regular food, she spit it out ㅋㅋㅋ The mini Brussels sprouts in the mix are seriously adorable and look like little beads. This was a successful first treat review for our baby pup!!

reviews.content:
우리 멈머 두마리 다 흰자를 보이면서 륄리염염챱 
안그래도 귀여운거 주는데 먹는 멈머들 넘귀엽규ㅜ
다양하게 줘봤는데 다 잘먹네요 
예쁜 건강한 간식 감사합니당 >_<ෆ
reviews.content_en: Both my dogs are showing the whites of their eyes going all bouncy and happy 😍 They're already so cute, but watching them eat makes them even cuter ㅜ I've given them various ones and they eat them all well! Thank you for the pretty, healthy treats >_<ෆ

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
지방분해를 못하는 아이가 있어 주로 간식은 야채와 과일
보자마자 낼름 4통 구입했어요
외출시나 귀차니즘이 올때 먹이려구요
울 애기들 역시나 잘 먹네요
reviews.content_en: I have a pup that can't digest fats well, so I mainly give vegetables and fruits as treats. As soon as I saw this, I bought 4 containers! I'm going to use them when I go out or when I'm feeling lazy. My babies eat it well, of course!

reviews.name: 박****
reviews.content:
방울양배추 비트 단호박 당근이 들어있는게 특히 마음에 쏙 들어요~
알러지때문에 고기,우유 모두 못줘서 ㅠㅠ
항상 오마이도기 연근 두부 딸기 블루베리정도만 가끔주는데 통도 그렇고 요러가지가 들어가있어 만족스럽네요~
다행히 방울 양배추도 잘 먹어요~
세개 구매했는데 1개반 남은거 실화인가요???
달마다 구매할거같아요~ㅎㅎ
reviews.content_en:
I especially love that it contains mini Brussels sprouts, beets, kabocha squash, and carrots~
Because of allergies, they can't have meat or dairy ㅠㅠ So I usually only give them things like sweet potato, lotus root, tofu, strawberries, and blueberries occasionally. This has such a variety that I'm really satisfied~ Thankfully they eat the mini Brussels sprouts well too~ I bought three and one and a half is already gone—is this real??? I think I'll be buying this every month hehe

reviews.name: 남****
reviews.content:
밥에 토핑으로도 주고, 간식으로도 주고 있습니다
통에 들어있어서 뚜껑 닫아서 냉장보관하니 편하네요!
요즘 살쪄서 간식 주기 신경쓰였는데 딱 좋습니다🙂
reviews.content_en: I give it as a topping on food and as a treat too. Since it comes in a container and I can close the lid and store it in the fridge, it's really convenient! I was worried about giving treats since my pup has been gaining weight lately, but this is perfect 🙂

reviews.name: 황****
reviews.content:
건사료위에 토핑해주니 잘 먹어요 ^^
밥안먹을때 치트키로 요긴하게 쓰일거같아요!ㅋㅋㅋ
육류 트릿 뿌려줬는데 알러지가 올라와서 구입해봤어요. 건조식품이라 유통기한도 길고 좋네요.
reviews.content_en: My pup eats it well when I use it as a topping on dry food ^^ I think this will be useful as a cheat code when they won't eat their meals! ㅋㅋㅋ I bought this because they had an allergic reaction to meat treats. Since it's a dried product, the expiration date is long too, which is great.

reviews.name: 박****
reviews.content: 야채간식은 처음이라 처음엔 요물조물 음미하더니 한개 물고 켄넬에 들어가서 뇸뇸 맛있게 먹고 또 달라고 난리네요😀 사료 토핑으로 올려주려고 구매한건데 보상용 간식으로도 너무 좋을 것 같아요 !❤️ 엄청 잘먹어요 !~
reviews.content_en: This is my pup's first veggie treat, so at first they nibbled on it thoughtfully, but then grabbed one piece, went into their kennel, and ate it deliciously going munch munch, asking for more! 😀 I bought it to use as a topping on regular food, but I think it would be great as a reward treat too! They eat it so well! ❤️

reviews.name: 최****
reviews.content: 다이어트 중이라 야채간식 먹이는 중인데 마침 딱 출시되서 사료 주문하면서 같이 주문해봤어요! 알록달록 귀여운 야채들이 안에 알차게 들어있고 아이도 엄청 잘먹어요!
reviews.content_en: My pup is on a diet so I've been giving veggie treats, and this came out at just the right time, so I ordered it together with their food! The colorful veggies are packed nicely inside and my pup eats them so well!

reviews.name: 여름
reviews.content:
원물의 향과 모양이 살아있는 것도, 작은 강아지가 먹기에 사이즈가 적당한 것도 너무 마음에 들어요!
저희 집 강아지는 많이 급하게 먹는 편이라 크기가 큰 간식은 그대로 토해서 항상 잘라주거든요ㅜㅜ 그런데 이 바잇미 베지믹스는 크기가 적당해서 급여하는 저도 먹는 강아지도 편한 간식이에요! 
게다가 채소라서 다이어트 걱정도 덜 수 있어서 좋고, 기호성도 좋아요! 그냥 보상 간식으로 줘도 잘 먹는데, 밥꾸 해주면 알록달록 해서 너무너무 귀여워요..♡
reviews.content_en: I love that the original texture and shape of the vegetables are preserved, and the size is perfect for a small dog to eat! My pup tends to eat in a rush, so with large treats they just vomit them back up and I always have to cut them—but BITE ME Veggie Mix has the right size so it's convenient for both me giving it and my pup eating it! Plus since it's vegetables, I can worry less about diet, and the palatability is great! Even just as a reward treat my pup eats it well, but when I make it into a meal topper it looks so colorful and adorable ♡

reviews.name: 연****
reviews.content:
먹성이 너무너무 좋은 아이라 아무거나 잘먹긴하는데 야채가 강아지에게 소화가 더 잘된다고 해서 사봤습니다~
첨에 받았을땐 통이 생각보다 작아서 금방먹겠는데 했는데 아이가 먹기좋은 크기로 작게 잘려있어서 생각보다많아요! 그리고 건조된거라 그런지 바삭바삭하게 과자처럼 먹네요 ㅎㅎㅎ
근데 미니통 양배추는 첨에 당황해해요....먹을줄 몰라서 그런지..?암튼 잘먹어요 ㅋㅋㅋ원래 암거나 잘먹는애긴하지만
reviews.content_en: My pup has an amazing appetite and eats anything, but I bought this because I heard vegetables are easier for dogs to digest~ When I first got it, the container looked smaller than I expected so I thought we'd finish it quickly, but since it's cut into bite-sized pieces, there's actually more than I thought! And since it's dried, it's nice and crunchy like crackers hehe But the little mini Brussels sprouts confused her at first... maybe because she didn't know how to eat them? Anyway she eats them well ㅋㅋㅋ She eats anything anyway

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 구매한지 2주 정도가 되었는데요! 너무 잘 먹어요 바삭바삭하고 달짝지근 하니 저도 조금 먹었습니다 ㅎㅎ 그리고 미니 양배추? 같은 것도 있어서 값에 비해 좋은 퀄리티 같아요
reviews.content_en: It's been about 2 weeks since I bought it and my pup eats it so well! It's crunchy and sweet-savory, so I even had a little bite myself hehe And there are mini Brussels sprouts and such, so the quality is great for the price!

reviews.name: 최****
reviews.content:
제 소울메이트가 워낙 육식을 좋아하다보니 영양밸런스를 맞춰주고싶어서 사봤습니다ㅎ 안 먹지는 않을까 걱정했는데 처음에는 가아끔 뱉어낼 때도 있었지만ㅎ 지금은 밥에 섞어줘도 싹싹 긁어먹고 그냥 줘도 바삭바삭 ASMR을 들려주며 잘 먹어요!! (지금 이 순간에도 제 앞에서 냠냠 잘 먹고있습니다ㅋㅋ) 두 통째 먹이고 있는데 다 먹이고 나서 또 사주려고요!ㅎ
앞으로도 바잇미 베지믹스랑 디톡스틱, 슬림스틱으로 영양밸런스 잘 맞춰서 지금보다 더 튼튼하고 건강하고 이쁜 울트라캡짱완소퍼펙트갱얼쥐가 되었으면 좋겠숩니당💛
reviews.content_en: Since my soulmate really loves meat, I bought this to balance her nutrition hehe I was worried she wouldn't eat it, and at first she would spit it out occasionally, but now when I mix it with her food she scarfs it all down, and even when I give it plain she eats it with satisfying crunchy ASMR sounds ㅋㅋ She's eating it right now in front of me! I'm using two whole containers and once we finish, I'm going to buy more! Going forward, I want to balance her nutrition well with BITE ME Veggie Mix, Detox Stick, and Slim Stick so that our ultra-cute perfect baby becomes even stronger, healthier, and more beautiful 💛

reviews.name: 박****
reviews.content: 디키랑 동결건조 사료를 주고 있는데 위에 올라가는 토핑이 없어서 늘 허전해 보였어요 ㅠ 배지 믹스를 보고 토핑으로 써도 될 거 같아서 올려주는데 밥이 호전해 보이지도 않고 야채라 알러지 걱정도 없어서 너무 만족합니다.
reviews.content_en: I feed my pup freeze-dried food and there's no topping to go on top so it always looked bare ㅠ I saw the Veggie Mix and thought it would work as a topping, so I put it on top. Not only does the food look better, but since it's vegetables there's no allergy worry either, so I'm very satisfied.

reviews.name: 정****
reviews.content:
매일 밥에 조금씩 넣어줘요.
70그람 먹이다 30그람으로 샀어요.
3통 사도 금방 먹을 듯 합니다.
가성비는 바잇미 베지믹스가 쵝오인듯 해요.
타 브랜드 너무 적은 양에비싸용.
꾸준히 잘 먹일게요.
5월초구매. 제조일 22년12월19일로 유통기한 적당해용
reviews.content_en: I put a little in her food every day. I was feeding 70g before but bought the 30g version now. Even if I buy 3 containers they'll probably be gone soon. I think BITE ME Veggie Mix has the best value for money. Other brands give such small amounts for the price. I'll keep feeding it consistently. Purchased early May. Expiration date is fine with a manufacturing date of Dec 19, 2022.

reviews.name: 조****

reviews.name: 정****
reviews.content:
동결건조 밥에 토핑으로 넣어주고 있어요.
일부 브랜드 동결건조 채소를 눈으로 직접보고 사면(투명뵹투로 팔때는)괜찮았는데 안보이는 봉투로 바뀐거 사서 집에 와서 뜯어보면 죄다 그린빈에 비트만 가득있는게 많았고 온라인 구매로 산것들도 대부분 채소가 골고루 안들어 있는게 많은데
바잇미 리틀팜 베지믹스는 채소도 잘 섞여서 들어있고 크기도 적당해서 주기 좋아요.
저는 동결건조 밥에 넣어주는데 물에 불려서 흐물흐물하면 아이가 골라내서 저는 엄지 검지로 눌러서 가루내서 뿌려줘요.그냥 주면 잘 먹는데 물에 불리면 싫어해서 가루내 주는데 싹싹 잘 먹습니다.
호박은 단단해서 잘 안부숴지는데 다른 채소들은 잘 부숴져요. 4개만 사려다 6개세트 구성 할인도 더 해줘서 6개로 구매했어요. 다 먹음 또 구매할게요.
reviews.content_en: I put it as a topping on freeze-dried food. Some freeze-dried veggie brands were okay when I could see them directly before buying (when they were sold in transparent packaging), but when they switched to non-transparent bags and I opened them at home, most were just full of green beans and beets, and most online purchases don't have well-mixed vegetables either. But BITE ME Little Farm Veggie Mix has well-mixed vegetables and the right size, so it's easy to give. I put it on freeze-dried food, and when I soak it in water and it gets mushy my pup picks it out, so I crush it into powder with my thumb and forefinger and sprinkle it. She eats it plain just fine, but when it's soaked she doesn't like it, so I give it as powder and she eats it all clean. The kabocha is firm and doesn't break down easily, but other vegetables break down well. I was only going to buy 4 but they offered a discount on a 6-pack set so I got 6. Once I finish these I'll buy more.
